purpose: Find nonduplicate external mechanisms that can improve exact causal trace binding, matched intervention/control evaluation, evidence provenance and agent-run falsification around the current Frankenstein-2.0 GWT uptake frontier without granting observability or model outputs canonical truth authority.

architecture_delta_fusion.current_frontier: WP507 G3 has repository-component CI evidence but actual GWT uptake, hidden-state causality, physical GRID10 and whole-system runtime credit remain zero/unproven.
architecture_delta_fusion.nonduplication_result: Repository search found no existing Trigger-6 records for OpenTelemetry, OpenInference, Inspect AI, in-toto Attestation or DoWhy in the Research-Entity tool-intelligence corpus. This scout remains E0 discovery only; no E1/E2 claim is created here.

research_question: Which external mechanisms can strengthen F2's exact matched intervention/control traceability and falsification discipline while keeping observation distinct from semantic uptake and keeping telemetry distinct from causal/world truth?

primary_sources.observed_mechanism: SpanContext is immutable and propagates TraceId/SpanId; spans provide parent-child structure, timestamped events and explicit Links to other SpanContexts, including cross-trace links. Context propagation is standardized through propagators.
OpenInference layers AI-specific Agent, Tool, LLM, Retriever, Guardrail and Evaluator span kinds plus typed input/output/model/token attributes on OpenTelemetry traces.

Inspect is an evaluation framework with multi-turn/tool-use support, extensible scorers, re-scoring of logs and transcript/scanner workflows suitable for evaluating agent behavior without embedding the evaluator into the agent runtime.

Attestation Statements bind subject artifacts to typed predicates; Link predicates bind materials/products and execution steps; test-result predicates bind test outcomes to tested source; runtime-trace predicates can carry monitor identity/config plus process/network/file-access traces; SVR can summarize verified properties while keeping verifier/policy identity explicit.

DoWhy exposes explicit causal refuters including random common cause, unobserved common cause, placebo treatment, data subset, bootstrap and dummy-outcome refuters, with reproducible random seeds supported by the API.

proposed_pending_research_rows.hypothesis: A thin F2-native adoption of immutable trace/span identity plus explicit Span-Link-like relationships can bind GRID/GWT broadcast, receipt, intervention and control evidence across asynchronous boundaries without making telemetry canonical state.
proposed_pending_research_rows.counterhypothesis: Trace graphs only encode instrumentation relationships; sampling, missing spans or late attributes can create false completeness, and a full OpenTelemetry SDK may add more overhead than a small F2-native schema.

proposed_pending_research_rows.hypothesis: AI-aware span kinds and typed model/tool/token attributes may reduce bespoke telemetry schema work and make F2 agent/tool traces easier to compare across implementations while reusing OpenTelemetry identity semantics.
proposed_pending_research_rows.counterhypothesis: It overlaps AgentSight/agenttop and F2-native telemetry, may capture sensitive payloads, and cannot distinguish delivered information from semantic uptake or establish causality by itself.

proposed_pending_research_rows.hypothesis: Inspect can serve as a noncanonical external E4-style ablation harness for matched GWT intervention/control runs, deterministic custom scorers, transcript inspection and re-scoring, improving falsification quality without entering F2 truth/effect authority.
proposed_pending_research_rows.counterhypothesis: The full framework may be heavy, provider/model-grading paths can contaminate deterministic evidence, and a small F2-native fixture runner may reproduce the needed functionality at lower complexity.

proposed_pending_research_rows.hypothesis: A thin in-toto-compatible receipt envelope can bind exact source/material digests, test/runtime monitor identity and result predicates so F2/Trigger-6 evidence remains self-describing and harder to detach from the artifact actually evaluated.
proposed_pending_research_rows.counterhypothesis: Supply-chain attestation semantics do not prove runtime cognition or world truth; full signing/verification infrastructure may be unnecessary overhead if current hash-bound receipts already cover the same integrity properties.

proposed_pending_research_rows.hypothesis: DoWhy's placebo/dummy-outcome/random-confounder/subset refuter patterns can donate stronger negative-control designs for repeated GWT causal experiments and help detect spurious intervention effects.
proposed_pending_research_rows.counterhypothesis: DoWhy assumes an explicit causal/statistical model over observed variables and does not convert a deterministic matched-pair trace into hidden-state causality; importing the library would likely be heavier than copying the falsifier patterns.

fusion_findings.claim: The highest-value near-term combination is not a new runtime agent framework. It is a thin exact-trace envelope (OpenTelemetry-like identity/links plus in-toto-like subject/material/result binding) paired with an external deterministic ablation harness (Inspect-like).
fusion_findings.falsifier: E1/E2 source archaeology shows that the required fields cannot be isolated without importing substantial runtime machinery, or current F2 receipts already provide equivalent immutable cross-run linkage and exact subject/material binding with lower complexity.

fusion_findings.claim: OpenInference is useful mainly as an interoperability/schema donor; it must not be promoted ahead of AgentSight/agenttop/F2-native telemetry until duplication and payload-privacy costs are mapped.
fusion_findings.falsifier: E2 mapping shows a uniquely required AI semantic convention or integration surface absent from the existing telemetry donors and cheaper than a small F2-native extension.

fusion_findings.claim: DoWhy should not be used to claim GWT hidden-state causality from current WP507 contract evidence. Its immediate value is negative-control methodology, not architecture/runtime proof.
fusion_findings.falsifier: A future F2 experiment exposes a sufficiently large, well-defined repeated-sample causal model with observed treatment/outcome/confounder variables and predeclared assumptions that DoWhy can test without substituting statistical association for the hidden-state claim.

coordination.reason: This run creates E0 discovery hypotheses only. Per Trigger-6 protocol, create-only objective claims are required before source archaeology/experiment/integration evidence-stage work. Each E1/E2 successor must first inspect claims/README.md and atomically claim its exact objective in canonical F2.

next_information_target: Claim and perform E1/E2 on R6-SEED-012 Inspect AI first, then R6-SEED-013 in-toto Attestation. The discriminator is whether a thin deterministic ablation/receipt layer gives more causal-evidence quality per dependency and token/runtime cost than existing F2-native test/receipt machinery.
